items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji Picker
items.description: Emoji picker and iMessage-style tapback with Slack shortcodes, skin tones, custom emoji and replaceable search. Built on @brianhung/emoji-picker-react.

items.name: emoji-picker-popover
items.title: Emoji Picker Popover
items.description: The emoji picker in your shadcn/ui popover (Base UI or Radix): a trigger that opens it, picking closes it.

items.name: emoji-picker-popover-aria
items.title: Emoji Picker Popover (React Aria)
items.description: The emoji picker in your shadcn/ui React Aria popover: a trigger that opens it, picking closes it.

items.name: emoji-prosemirror
items.title: Emoji ProseMirror
items.description: Shortcode suggestions as a ProseMirror plugin, without React: finds the :query, handles the keys and replaces the query with the chosen emoji.

items.name: emoji-tiptap
items.title: Emoji Tiptap
items.description: useTiptapEmojiTypeahead: shortcode suggestions for a Tiptap 3 editor, on the ProseMirror plugin.

items.name: emoji-lexical
items.title: Emoji Lexical
items.description: useLexicalEmojiTypeahead: shortcode suggestions for a Lexical editor, inside LexicalComposer.
